reference.title: Clues in the tenses
reference.text: Janet Leigh died in 2004, so her paragraphs use the past simple (She was married four times). Jamie Lee Curtis is alive, so hers often use the present perfect (She has been married for more than 20 years).

reference.title: Writing a biography
reference.text: Use the past simple for finished events in the person's life (He was born in 1970. He went to Harvard). Use the present perfect for things that are still true or for experiences up to now (He has appeared in over 70 films. He has been married since 2005).

tasks.context:
Like mother, like daughter

Janet Leigh (1927–2004) was one of film director Alfred Hitchcock's favourite actresses, and was in more than 50 films and many TV series. Her daughter Jamie Lee Curtis (1958–) is also a successful actress.

exercises.text:
She had two children from her third marriage to actor Tony Curtis. The marriage lasted 11 years. She then married again, and this marriage lasted for the rest of her life.
This is about {}.

She has been in many different kinds of films, including the comedies Trading Places, A Fish Called Wanda, and True Lies, for which she won a Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Musical or Comedy. She has also starred in the comedy-horror TV series Scream Queens. In one episode she recreated the famous scream from Psycho.
This is about {}.

She has been married for more than 20 years to actor, screenwriter, and director Christopher Guest. She became Lady Haden-Guest when her husband became Baron Haden-Guest after the death of his father.
This is about {}.

She was married four times. At the age of 15 (pretending to be 18) she married 18-year-old John Kenneth. They got divorced four months later.
This is about {}.

She has written several bestselling children's books. She says she finds the inspiration for her writing all around her – in the experiences of her children, her godchildren (one is actor Jake Gyllenhaal), her friends, and of course in her own life.
This is about {}.

She is a fan of World of Warcraft, and has been to events such as ComicCon and BlizzCon.
This is about {}.

Her most famous role was the victim in Psycho, for which she won the Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actress and received an Oscar nomination. However she was traumatized by the iconic shower scene, and for the rest of her life she never had showers, only baths.
This is about {}.

She is close friends with actress Sigourney Weaver. In an interview, she admitted that she has never watched Weaver's film Alien the whole way through because she was too scared.
This is about {}.

She was in five films, including Houdini, with Tony Curtis, and also starred opposite Frank Sinatra and Paul Newman.
This is about {}.

She wrote four books. The first, the memoir There really was a Hollywood, became a New York Times bestseller.
This is about {}.

reference.title: Finished or unfinished?
rows: How long was Janet Leigh married to Tony Curtis?
How long has Jamie Lee Curtis been married?
She was married to him for 11 years.
How many books did she write?
What kind of books has she written?

reference.text: Use the past simple for a finished period of time in the past: Janet Leigh was married to Tony Curtis for 11 years (they are not married now). Use the present perfect + for / since for an unfinished period of time, from the past until now: Jamie Lee Curtis has been married since 1984 (she is married now).

reference.title: for with past simple and present perfect
reference.text: Jack was married for ten years = he isn't married now. Jack has been married for ten years = he is married now.

reference.wrong: She has been married to him for 11 years. (they are divorced)
reference.right: She was married to him for 11 years.
reference.why: A finished period in the past → past simple.

exercises.situation: You are a classmate in an English class (level: pre-intermediate). The student is going to tell you about an older person they know well (a friend or family member who is alive).
